messages:
Ashley Ramos: Heads-up - I'm opening a relnotes draft for the upcoming 'batching presets + KV-cache improvements' release. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4837 :memo:
Kevin Chen: Nice. Can you paste the short bullets you want in the summary? I can tidy wording and add the SDK snippet changes.
Ashley Ramos: Quick bullets draft: 1) New built-in batching presets to reduce tail latency for mixed workloads. 2) KV cache improvements: more aggressive prefix reuse and smaller mem footprint. 3) Router policy tweak: prefer local-in-region for lower p99. 4) Known issue: canary metrics may underreport latency when prefix caching warms up.
Sophie Patel: For (1) can we call out the presets names? 'interactive-low-latency', 'throughput-balanced', 'cost-saver-v1' 
Ashley Ramos: Yep adding names. Also need one sentence for migration: consumers with custom batching should opt into presets v1 via route config.
Kevin Chen: I'll add SDK snippet for Python + JS. Quick preview:
```
# python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
c.routes.update("my-route", batching_preset="interactive-low-latency")
```
and for JS:
```
// js
await client.routes.update('my-route', { batchingPreset: 'interactive-low-latency' })
```
Sophie Patel: +1. Also add a short example for dedicated customers (how to pin preset per pool).
Jon Harris: Known issues — capture this exactly: "When enabling presets on legacy routes, existing continuous-batch windows may cause transient p50/p95 spikes for 1-2 minutes while caches rebalance."
Ashley Ramos: Good wording. Sophie can you add the dedicated pool note + example config? Kevin will drop the SDK samples into the PR. I'll make the short announcement blurb for whats-new.
Sophie Patel: On it. Draft for dedicated pool pin: `poolConfig: { batchingPreset: 'throughput-balanced' }` and a note to restart long-running workers.
Kevin Chen: Pushed the JS/Python snippets to the PR and left comments on where to put the code blocks. Also added a small callout for downstream API changes (none backwards-incompatible).
docs-bot: Reminder: When PR is > 1 file change, please add a changelog entry under /docs/whats-new with frontmatter: 
```
---
date: 2025-06-03
title: "Batching presets & KV cache improvements"
components: [runtime, routing]
---
```
Ashley Ramos: Thanks bot. I'll add frontmatter and a short TL;DR.
Kevin Chen: Small nit: include a note under known issues linking to incident tracker if we see canary problems: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-2123
Ashley Ramos: Added that link + flagged for post-rollout watch. Anyone object to merging after Sophie drops the dedicated example?
Sophie Patel: No objections. Will drop in a minute. :white_check_mark:
Jon Harris: After merge please ping eng-oncall for the first hour of rollout so they watch prefix warming.
Ashley Ramos: Will do. Thanks all — I'll schedule the whats-new publish for tomorrow morning PST. :rocket:
